entries.37d3e05fa22737c4: In line with its management philosophy, it sets out to further strengthen the proprietary core technologies it has cultivated over many years, comprehensively utilize these technologies to build its own business fields, and further raise its positioning as a development-type company whose existence value is recognized by customers. It positions focusing its businesses and differentiation from other companies as important strategies, intensively concentrates management resources on business fields and markets where growth is expected in the future, and, in manufacturing and sales, its policy is to focus on differentiating coating products and high-performance resin products and launching newly developed products with high added value on the market, and, in purchasing and sales, on joint development and other collaboration with suppliers and acquiring new trading rights. In global expansion, it places emerging markets such as China, Thailand, Vietnam and India at the center of its business activities, with subsidiaries in various parts of Asia as bases, and also seeks to strengthen production, logistics and sales functions in the United States and Europe.
